zh_CN:
哈伦，南岗昨夜交班晚了。明天让夜班多领一罐灯油，再叫厨房把汤留到最后一班回来。名册上的出塔时间写清楚。谁该回来还没回来，就留着那一栏空白，晨钟前交给我。

灯要照在台阶上。交班的人从下面来，最后几阶最暗。

埃德里克·沃恩
en_US:
Harlan, the south watch changed late last night. Give the night watch another tin of oil tomorrow and tell the kitchen to keep the soup on until the last shift is back. Set down the time each person leaves the tower. If anyone is overdue, leave that line in the roll open and bring it to me before the morning bell.

Keep the lamp turned toward the stair. The last few steps are the darkest for the men coming up.

Edric Vane
_context: 百余年前旧王国领主埃德里克·沃恩在夺舍前写给哈伦，第一层东侧清场后拾取。署名与 LORE_RESEARCH_BODY 一致。正文可分段和滚动。
约八十年前的灾变年，由领主下属哈伦写成，第二层西北侧清场后拾取。用军报口吻，按异变、精锐失踪及王国灭亡推进，保留古塔几乎无损的反常。阅读面板标题，也用作拾取与背包名称。

zh_CN:
呈守塔领主。灾变后第十四日，东道派来的传令兵到了。他说王廷出了黑魔法，最先失联的是王城外的三处哨站。来自东道的车队在午后就听见城外的钟，之后没有一队赶在关门前回来。夜里有军伍经过山口，火把望不到尽头。我们等到了天亮，仍没有看见旧王国的旗。

到第二个月，王国精锐循着怪物大军来时的方向进发。我们能听见那场战斗，在塔上也能看见远处的烟。第三天，有一匹空鞍的马回到东道，鞍袋里还有没用完的饼。此后再无消息。原定入塔换防的那一队也没有回来，名册上还留着他们的行。

夏末，王都的回令断了。入冬前，最后两处还挂旧旗的城门也失守了。从异变起算，到王国覆灭还不到一年。我们检查了每层墙脚和承梁。西梯断了一阶，塔身几乎无损。预定今日交班的人已经到齐，共十一人。请核定余下的灯油和粮食。

哈伦，代南岗呈报
en_US:
To the lord of the tower. On the fourteenth day of the calamity, a courier reached us by the east road. He spoke of black magic at court. The first posts to fall silent were the three outside the capital. The wagons on the east road heard the city's bells that afternoon, and none came back before the gates were shut. That night a host passed through the mountain gap. We could see no end to its torches. We waited for dawn and did not see the old kingdom's banner among them.

In the second month the royal guard marched along the road by which the host had come. We could hear their battle and see the smoke from the tower. On the third day a riderless horse came back along the east road, with half a loaf still in the saddlebag. No word followed. The company due to relieve us never returned, either. Their lines in the roll are still open.

By late summer the capital had ceased to answer. Before winter the last two gates that flew the royal banner were taken. Less than a year had passed from the first disturbance to the fall of the kingdom. We checked the foot of every wall and every beam we could reach. One tread on the west stair is broken. The tower itself has scarcely suffered. All eleven of today's relief have reported. Please confirm how much oil and grain they can draw.

Harlan, for the south watch

zh_CN:
回声总比我快半步，像有人在前头替我数台阶。三层往上，墙上的箭孔都朝里开。守卫站在孔后，射得到上楼的人，照应不到塔外。

我把火把插进一个孔里，想测量回身向下时能避开的角度。孔边有更旧的焦痕。最深的一块在里墙上，低得像有人贴着地面爬过去。下次停步，把弓留在手里。

艾妲
en_US:
My echo runs half a step ahead of me, as if someone up there counts the stairs for me. From the third floor up, every arrow slit faces inward. A sentry behind one could shoot someone coming upstairs and see nothing beyond the tower.

I wedged my torch into a slit to find the angle I could get clear of when turning downhill. There were older scorch marks on the stone. The deepest was on the inner wall, low enough for someone crawling. Next time we stop, keep the bow in hand.

Ada

zh_CN:
哈伦的军报写了十一人。下一份还能查到的值夜记录里，十一行都是空栏。可领主的名字一直签了下去。同一个钩笔，连最后一划都压在同一个地方。以前每页都有灯油和换岗。到了后来的几册，签名上面全是灰重、持续时间和能否重复。

我试着照军报上的日期排这些记录。最早一次试验，紧接在王都最后一次回令后。灰的味道，和我装进半只水瓶的那把一模一样。明天请莱昂提灯上去，我要看看名册的空栏里有没有擦掉的字。

索伦
en_US:
Harlan's dispatch lists eleven. The next watch record I could find has eleven empty lines. Yet the lord's signature keeps turning up. The same hook in the pen stroke, the same pressure at the end. The early pages list lamp oil and changes of watch. In the later years, all that sits above the signature is the weight of ash, the duration, and whether the result could be repeated.

I put the records in order using the dates in the dispatch. The first trial followed the capital's last reply. The ash smells exactly like the handful I put in my half-empty bottle. Tomorrow I'll ask Leon to bring the lamp upstairs. I want to look for erased names in the empty lines of the roll.

Soren

I have trimmed this wick short seventeen times. Someone once brought a lamp upstairs to read the empty lines in the roll. Four people came that night. An old bowstring still lies beneath the lamp, soaked in oil. I have left it there.

十年前骑士莱昂所写，塔前营火南侧拾取时打开。弓箭手为艾妲，牧师为米拉，法师为索伦。阅读面板标题，也用作拾取与背包名称。

zh_CN:
四份干粮，一卷绷带，两罐灯油。艾妲试了三次弓弦，最后把最旧的那根也收进了袋里。米拉从午后就开始数我们有几个人。我说四个，她说已经数过了。

索伦只给自己的水瓶装了半瓶水，空出来的地方说是要装从塔里取来的灰。我把长剑和法杖放在门边，腾出手去搬灯油。

别把四个人的名字写在同一页，米拉说。下雨时，一页纸受潮，总得有别处能查。

莱昂
en_US:
Four rations, one roll of bandages, two tins of lamp oil. Ada tested three bowstrings and packed even the oldest. Mira has been counting us since noon. I said there were four of us. She said she knew.

Soren filled his bottle halfway. He wants room for ash from the tower. I left the sword and staff by the gate so I could carry the lamp oil.

Don't put all four names on the same page, Mira said. If rain ruins one page, there should be somewhere else to look.

Leon
_context: 十年前骑士莱昂所写，塔前营火南侧拾取时打开。弓箭手为艾妲，牧师为米拉，法师为索伦。正文可分段和滚动。

en_US: Garrison Order of the Old Kingdom
_context: 百余年前旧王国王廷发令，塔前东侧石地拾取时打开。保留领主署名的中文和英文拼写。阅读面板标题，也用作拾取与背包名称。

zh_CN:
奉王廷之命，派埃德里克·沃恩领主率本部下属进驻古塔。自抵达之日起，接管岗哨、器械及所有楼层的出入。交班须检灯油，出入须核名册。由领主本人按月报送缺员，不得以副本替代。

首任换防定于霜月初一。携令者先报姓名，由当值守卫引入。
en_US:
By order of the court, Lord Edric Vane and his company are to take up garrison duty at the old tower. On arrival they shall assume command of its watches, stores, and access to every floor. Check the lamp oil at each change of watch and enter each arrival and departure in the roll. The lord shall report any person missing at month's end under his own hand. A copy will not suffice.

The first relief is due on the first day of Frostmonth. The bearer of these orders will give their name to the sentry and be escorted inside.
_context: 百余年前旧王国王廷发令，塔前东侧石地拾取时打开。保留领主署名的中文和英文拼写。正文可分段和滚动。

zh_CN:
灰里还压着四块垫锅的石头。过路人说，十年前在这里扎营的四个人进了塔，一个也没回来。

也有人赶夜路时看见过模糊的身影。那些影子先俯身整理行装，一转眼又背靠背挥砍。等目击者走近，篝火已经冷了。
en_US:
Four stones still prop up the pot in the ashes. Travelers say the four who camped here ten years ago went into the tower. None ever came back.

Some who pass at midnight have seen figures bend to pack the gear and then, in the blink of an eye, draw up back to back and fight. By the time anyone gets close, the fire is cold.
_context: 玩家观察营地时汇集当代路人传闻，塔前营地按互动键显示。作为环境信息留在原地。正文可分段和滚动。
十年前牧师米拉记录进塔后最初的异样，第二层东南侧清场后拾取。阅读面板标题，也用作拾取与背包名称。

zh_CN:
请让莱昂今夜睡到换班。昨夜他两次把手伸向剑柄。我问他听见了什么。他说有人在上面念名册，每念到一个名字就停一会儿，好像在等人答到。

我数过我们带进来的脚步声。上楼时是四个人。后来有一声一直停在我们身后。

米拉
en_US:
Let Leon sleep tonight until his watch. Last night he reached for his sword twice. I asked what he heard. He said someone upstairs was calling the roll and pausing at every name, as if waiting for an answer.

I counted the steps we brought with us. Four of us came up the stairs. Afterward one set of footsteps always stopped just behind us.

Mira

zh_CN:
第十七次。连灯芯一同称灰。余烬保持了四息，回声仍迟一步。将名册摊在灯下，以旧字迹落笔，换一份新灰，明夜重试。

借来的手已经能维持小规模召唤。山口那一次需要的量记在另一页。再积一季，先在一层开一个口。门开时，把能回声的每条路都留着。

埃德里克·沃恩
en_US:
Seventeenth trial. Weigh the ash with the wick. The ember held for four breaths. The echo was still a step late. Open the roll under the lamp and write in the old hand. Use fresh ash and repeat tomorrow night.

The borrowed hand can now sustain a small summoning. The quantities for what came through the mountain gap are on a separate page. Another season to build up the supply, then open a breach on the first floor. When the gate opens, leave every road that can carry the echo open.

Edric Vane
